Name: Darker Demetrius for Seasonal Nyapu
Author: amillionand1fandoms
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A version of Demetrius with darker skin to match his sprite. It goes with AhCuteArt's seasonal Nyapu portraits and cannot be used without that.[/color] 
Technically this is just an overlay of the skin. The pictures above show how it appears in game, but the only assets this mod actually includes are edits of Nyapu's work, which has modification permissions.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Just unzip the folder wherever you keep your mods. You do not need to replace any images.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255?tab=description]SEASONAL SDV OUTFIT NYAPU STYLE RETEXTURES[/url] by AhCuteArt

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48647838]8027[/url] for creating the (as far as I know) original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1816]Darker Demetrius[/url] mod back in 2018
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]amazing portraits[/url] and open permissions
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/85498663]Oceannist[/url] for making a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21234?tab=description]Nyapu version[/url] of Darker Demetrius
and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/221588049]AhCuteArt[/url] for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255?tab=description]seasonal versions[/url] of Nyapu's portraits
Without those mods, this one wouldn't exist, so you should absolutely go endorse them!
